title: Clark City Marathon Finale 2026 Review: What the Race Was Like
seo_title: Clark City Marathon 2026 Review: Results, Weather, Field Depth
meta_description: Clark City Marathon 2026 review (Run in Clark Leg 3): 24°C and 89% humidity before dawn at Clark, 386 marathon finishers with a 5:19 median, and how fast the half and 10 km ran.
dek: What the last leg of the Run in Clark series was like on 18 October 2026: the weather at Clark before and after sunrise, and how fast each of the five races actually ran.
verdict: Enter if you want a mass-participation marathon close to Manila with a relaxed field. The 2026 race, the third and final leg of the Run in Clark series, had 386 marathon finishers, 976 in the half and 1,126 in the 10 km, and half the marathoners took longer than 5:19. Clark airport recorded a mild 24°C at 89% humidity before dawn, but it was 29°C by 9am and 31°C by 10am. The organiser published little about the course, aid or cut-offs, so ask before you enter.

sections.heading: The Race and the Course
paragraphs: The Clark City Marathon Finale, organised by Speedstar Sports, closes the three-leg Run in Clark series [2]. The 2026 race started and finished at the Filinvest Mimosa Plus Event Grounds on MA Roxas Highway in the Clark Freeport Zone, with a marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and 3 km [1][2]. The organiser bills it as a scenic marathon [1], but no route map, start times, cut-offs or aid-station plan were published on the entry pages.

sections.heading: The Weather: Mild Before Dawn, Hot by Mid-Morning
paragraphs: Clark International Airport, about 3 km from the start, recorded 24°C with a dew point of 22°C, 89% humidity and a 2-knot wind every hour from 3am to 5am on race morning, under a few clouds [3]. It was 25°C at 6am and 7am, 27°C at 8am, 29°C at 9am and 31°C at 10am, with cloud thickening from 8am [3].

That is benign air for the Philippines before sunrise, but the marathon is long here: a runner at the median pace of 5:19 spent the last hour or more in temperatures from 27°C upwards. Plan to finish early, or pace for the heat after 8am.

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: The marathon had 386 finishers. It was won in 2:58:00 by a man and 3:43:59 by a woman; tenth place was 3:39:25, and tenth woman ran 4:44:28 [4]. The median finisher took 5:19:14 and the slowest tenth more than 6:32. Only 7% broke four hours and 40% broke five; 16% of finishers were women, and 14 took longer than seven hours [4].

The half marathon had 976 finishers. It was won in 1:25:44 and 1:43:35, with tenth place at 1:42:53, a median of 2:41:56 and a slowest tenth beyond 3:25; 9% broke two hours, 37% broke 2:30, and 29% of finishers were women [4]. The 10 km was the largest timed race, with 1,126 finishers, a median of 1:28:59, 7% under an hour and half of them women [4].
These are slow, inclusive fields. A 4:30 marathoner would have finished in the top fifth, and a two-hour half marathoner in the top tenth [4].

sections.heading: Race Weekend Logistics
paragraphs: Race kits were claimed with the confirmation QR code and a photo ID; someone collecting for another runner needed a copy of that runner's QR code and ID [1]. Runners under 18 had to bring a printed, signed parental consent form, and kit delivery was offered, with dates announced by email and on Facebook [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the Next Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a marathon near Manila where finishing is the goal and you will have plenty of company at five to six hours.

Think twice if you need a published course, aid plan and cut-offs before you commit; for 2026 the entry pages gave none. Ask the organiser, especially about the time limit if you expect to take more than seven hours.
A 2027 date had not been announced when this was written.
Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on the entry pages, the full results and airport weather records.

faqs.question: How fast is the Clark City Marathon field?
faqs.answer: Slow and inclusive. In 2026, 386 runners finished the marathon with a median of 5:19:14, and only 7% broke four hours. It was won in 2:58:00 by a man and 3:43:59 by a woman. A 4:30 marathoner would have finished in the top fifth of the field.

faqs.question: What is the weather like at the Clark City Marathon?
faqs.answer: Mild before dawn and hot by mid-morning. On race morning in 2026 Clark airport recorded 24°C and 89% humidity from 3am to 5am with almost no wind. It reached 27°C at 8am, 29°C at 9am and 31°C at 10am, so slower marathoners finish in real heat.

faqs.question: How many runners take part in the Clark City Marathon?
faqs.answer: In 2026, 386 runners finished the marathon, 976 the half marathon and 1,126 the 10 km, with 5 km and 3 km races as well. Women made up 16% of marathon finishers, 29% in the half and half of the 10 km field.

editorial_notes: Written 2026-11-06 about the edition that ran on Sunday 18 October 2026; the next edition's date was not found. Evidence beyond the results is thin: no gun times, cut-offs, route map, aid plan, fees or runner accounts were found on any page that could be opened, and the organiser's Facebook page could not be read. Finish-time figures are Run SEA's analysis of the official RaceTech PH results (whether gun or chip time is not stated). Weather is from Clark airport METAR, beside the venue; because gun times are unknown, it is given for the whole early morning. The Leg 2 race and the separate Clark international marathons are different events and are not used. No rating.
